sources.used_for: Worked example uses IEC at 0.001 EUR/kWh, IVA normal at 23 percent and IVA reduzida at 6 percent. A social-tariff CAV line uses 1.85 EUR/month. None of these is applied unless supplied as an input.

reactive_eur_per_kvarh.reason: The upload has no reactive-energy series, so reactive access is not charged.

not_applied.seasonal_peak_option: The MT opção tarifária por épocas uses different peak-power prices by season. This assessment uses the standard potência em horas de ponta price. The epoch calendar is not applied.

supplier_margin_eur_per_kwh.source: ERSE: in the liberalized market the energy and commercialization component is set by the supplier, not by the access tariff. https://www.erse.pt/atividade/regulacao/tarifas-e-precos-eletricidade/

loss_factor.source: ERSE publishes coeficientes de ajustamento para perdas by period and voltage in the tariff-structure documents. No single verified coefficient is stored here. A supplied factor multiplies only the OMIE energy term.

iva_rate.source: ERSE nota da tarifa social, outubro 2026, which states the taxa normal de IVA (23%) and the taxa reduzida (6%). https://www.erse.pt/media/vhajllzh/tarifa-social-eletricidade-out2026.pdf Lei n.º 38/2024 is the VAT change cited by ERSE in Estrutura tarifária do setor elétrico em 2026. Which rate applies to a BTE or MT bill is not chosen by this file.

iec_eur_per_kwh.source: CIEC artigo 92.º fixes the mainland electricity band at 1 to 1.10 EUR/MWh and leaves the rate inside the band to a portaria. The October 2026 ERSE social-tariff leaflet multiplies by 0.001 EUR/kWh in one worked example. That example is not applied unless you pass iec_eur_per_kwh.

cav_eur_per_month.source: ERSE names the Contribuição Audiovisual on the electricity bill. The October 2026 social-tariff leaflet shows 1.85 EUR/month on a vulnerable-customer example and a partial exemption of 1.85 EUR/month. The standard amount for this building was not verified, so nothing is charged unless cav_eur_per_month is supplied.

dgeg_eur_per_month.source: ERSE names the taxa da Direção-Geral de Energia e Geologia on the bill. The amount depends on the installation. No single official amount is stored.
